turns.question: What was our repeat purchase rate from 1 to 10 October 2026: of the customers who bought in that time, what share bought more than once?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no repeat purchase rate metric, so I cannot give that share; the closest metrics for 1 to 10 October 2026 are Repeat customers, 10 customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all, so the repeat count is over all time, not only this period) and Active customers, 17 customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order in the period). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
